fw.title: Your first week

container.s1: Open Maal aya and start a new container.
container.s2: Tap the supplier, write the invoice weight in kg and the purchase cost.
container.s3: Tap the charges you paid (freight, clearing, labour) and write each amount. You can add them later too.
container.s4: Save. The cost per kg is worked out, and Home shows the container's profit as you sell.
container.title: Receive a container

import.s1: Open Settings, then Bring in your register.
import.s2: Download the sheet and fill in customers with their udhaar, suppliers or stock.
import.s3: Choose the file and check the rows. Fix any row marked red.
import.s4: Tap Add. Adding the same file again does not add anything twice.
import.title: Bring in your paper register

khata.s1: Every udhaar sale is written in the customer's khata by itself.
khata.s2: Open Khata and tap the customer.
khata.s3: When money comes, tap Payment received, write the amount and save. You can print a receipt.
khata.s4: Tap Remind to send the balance on WhatsApp.
khata.title: Udhaar and payments

sale.s1: Open Becho and tap New sale.
sale.s2: Pick the customer, or add one with name and phone.
sale.s3: Pick the stock, write how many and the price.
sale.s4: Choose cash or udhaar and save. Send the bill on WhatsApp or print it.
sale.title: Make a sale

sorting.s1: Open Chhantai and tap the lot that is waiting.
sorting.s2: Tap a category, write the kg, save. Do the same for each pile.
sorting.s3: When the lot is finished, tap Close lot. What is left counts as waste.
sorting.s4: Sorted kg go to Stock by themselves, with their cost per kg.
sorting.title: Sort a lot

stock.s1: Open Stock and tap Make bale.
stock.s2: Tap the kind and write the bale weight in kg.
stock.s3: Save, then tap Print label for the QR sticker.
stock.s4: When you sell, scan the sticker and the bale is picked for you.
stock.title: Make a bale and its sticker

supplier.s1: Open Maal aya and start a new container.
supplier.s2: Under Which supplier?, tap + New supplier.
supplier.s3: Write the name and tap the country. That is all.
supplier.s4: Next time your supplier is the first tile. Profit per supplier shows in reports.
supplier.title: Add a supplier

team.s2: Tap Add munshi and write the name and phone number.
team.s3: Choose a 4-digit PIN and tell it to the munshi.
team.s4: The munshi signs in with phone and PIN, and sees floor work, not your profit.
team.title: Add your munshi

privacy.p1: What is kept: your business details; your users (name, email or phone); the customers and suppliers you add (name, WhatsApp number, city, balances); stock, sales and payments; and payment screenshots you upload.
privacy.p2: Why: only to run ThriftOS for your business — showing your records, the bills and reminders you choose to send on WhatsApp, and keeping the app working and safe.
privacy.p3: Who sees it: the people in your business you give access to, and the ThriftOS operator when you ask for help. Your data is not sold or shared. WhatsApp messages go from your own phone.
privacy.p4: Where: on a server in Australia (Amazon Web Services, Sydney), delivered through Amazon CloudFront over HTTPS. Server logs and error reports hold no names, phone numbers or amounts.
privacy.p5: How long: as long as your business uses ThriftOS. You can download everything at any time; ask the operator to delete your business when you leave.
privacy.p6: Questions or a request to correct or delete something: ask the person who set up ThriftOS for you.
privacy.title: Privacy

terms.p1: ThriftOS is software for running a used-clothing business: stock, sorting, sales, khata and reports. These terms apply when you or your staff use it.
terms.p2: Your data is yours. You can download all of it at any time from Settings → Download all my data, and you keep it if you stop using ThriftOS.
terms.p3: You are responsible for the people you give access to, for keeping passwords and PINs private, and for checking amounts and balances before you act on them.
terms.p4: We keep the service running as well as we can, but we cannot promise it will never be unavailable. Keep your own copy of important records.
terms.p5: Do not use ThriftOS for anything unlawful, or to keep other people's details without their permission.
terms.p6: We may change these terms; the date below changes when we do. Questions: ask the person who set up ThriftOS for you.
terms.title: Terms of use
